title: helm(private): values schema, init-hook ordering and Helm 3 compatibility fixes for upgrade/rollback
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: customers running Redwood Private on Helm 3 observed upgrade failures and hooks not executing reliably during rollback paths. This PR standardizes the values schema for the private chart, fixes templating edge cases (nil handling and toYaml spacing), makes init-job hooks robust to duplicate executions, and restores Helm 3 compatibility for hook annotations and CRD ordering. Changes include stricter schema validation for credentials and networking sections to prevent silent misconfigurations, adding hook weights and failurePolicy adjustments to ensure safe upgrades and deterministic rollback behavior, and small templating fixes to avoid render-time panics. This PR also adds an integration test that simulates an interrupted upgrade and validates automatic rollback retains persistent volumes and network attachments. See below for commit summary, changed files, and review discussion.
commits: refactor(values): normalize values.schema.json and add missing metadata
fix(templates): handle nil serviceAccount and default annotations
feat(hooks): add weight and failurePolicy to init-job hook to avoid race on rollback
test(integration): add helm upgrade/rollback scenario to e2e-private-installer tests
review_comments: Sofia Nguyen: Can you explain the reasoning for changing failurePolicy to 'Ignore' on the init-job? I want to make sure we don't silently skip important work.

Asha Patel: We keep critical validation as pre-install checks; the init-job is idempotent and only prepares local disk/networking metadata. Setting failurePolicy=Ignore avoids blocking a rollback path where the hook is re-run and might already have partially completed. We added additional checks to avoid double-applying side effects.
Miguel Torres: Left two nits on the templating (use default and quote toYaml outputs). Also please add a short migration note in README.
Asha Patel: Addressed both nits and added migration guidance + examples in README (included in this PR).
Rajat Singh: Integration tests look good. Verified PV retention and network attachments after simulated interrupted upgrade. Approving.
Sofia Nguyen: Approved after second CI run.
release_notes: Fix: Helm chart values schema and init-hook ordering for Redwood Private to improve upgrade/rollback reliability; add Helm 3 compatibility fixes and integration test for interrupted upgrades.
